ResearcherListRecord.description: Object with basic researcher metadata in the list.

hIndex.description:
The h-index (also known as Hirsch index) was introduced by J. Hirsch in 2005 and can be defined as follows: A researcher has an h-index, if they have at least h publications for which they have received at least h citations. For example, Researcher A has an h-index = 13 if they have published at least 13 documents for which they have received at least 13 citations.

>h-index is calculated using citation data from Web of Science Core Collection (including self-citations).

totalTimesCited.description: Total number of citations in Web of Science

authorships.description: Feedback about search match in the case of a topic search

SearchMatch.description: Displays the field and value matched to the search string

value.description: Array of matched values (if several) with the HTML highlighting
